summary: Three-phase, 1.5-hour plan for a single-file, purely additive change to Cslib/Logics/Propositional/ProofSystemEquivalence.lean. Phase 1 adds `public import Cslib.Logics.Propositional.Semantics.Algebra.HilbertCompleteness`, a `universe u` declaration, and a new `section WithAlgebra` (introducing no `variable` line) holding three documented four-way closed TFAE theorems — cplProofSystemsWithAlgebraTfae (node 4 `BAValid.{u, u}`), iplProofSystemsWithAlgebraTfae (`HAValid.{u, u}`), mplProofSystemsWithAlgebraTfae (`GHAValid.{u, u}`) — each proved by reusing the corresponding `...TfaeClosed` for nodes 1-3 plus a single `tfae_have 1 ↔ 4 := <logic>.hilbert_alg_completeness`. Phase 2 records the closed-only decision and its reason in the module and section docstrings. Phase 3 runs the full CSLib CI sequence plus zero-debt and unchanged-statement checks. Verification tiers: local, prose, full. All code was already compile-verified during research, so implementation is transcription from report section 5.2, not derivation.
